stories.new_fact: The Conference Board’s consumer-confidence index rose to 91.7 in October from 84.2 in September.
stories.new_takeaway: The bounce is a timing signal for household sentiment, not evidence that affordability pressure has resolved.
stories.why_now: The October release was published October 27.
stories.previous_coverage: The seven compared scripts did not cover this release.
stories.uncertainty: The survey dates and a single-month improvement limit inference about sustained spending.
stories.watch: Persistence after election, inflation, and jobs data.

stories.new_fact: Axios summarized early-vote, absentee, Election Day, ID, and competing City Council charter-amendment information for Columbus and Franklin County voters.
stories.new_takeaway: The newly useful local task is ballot-content preparation and deadline planning rather than reading turnout as an outcome forecast.
stories.why_now: The guide was published October 27 in the final week before Election Day.
stories.previous_coverage: October 27 covered Franklin County’s early in-person turnout threshold, not the two amendment designs.
stories.uncertainty: Reporting does not predict the result or substitute for official ballot language.
stories.watch: County deadline guidance and official ballot materials.

stories.new_fact: FHFA listed a new U.S. House Price Index report on October 27.
stories.new_takeaway: The release refreshes broad valuation and pipeline monitoring but does not alter individual eligibility, appraisal, or cancellation rules.
stories.why_now: The report was newly posted on October 27.
stories.previous_coverage: October 27 previewed the release; this edition uses the newly posted report as a workflow reference without recycling a prior price claim.
stories.uncertainty: The report listing alone does not establish a property-level or Central Ohio valuation conclusion.
stories.watch: Regional detail and comparison with locally admissible valuation evidence.

stories.new_fact: Wells Fargo announced Kleber Santos would lead Consumer Banking and Lending and Saul Van Beurden would lead AI for the company.
stories.new_takeaway: A public accountability move changes ownership visibility but is not proof of production AI performance.
stories.why_now: The dated announcement is within seven days and materially affects how a large bank may assign AI delivery accountability.
stories.previous_coverage: The last seven scripts did not cover this Wells Fargo leadership status move.
stories.uncertainty: No named workflow, baseline, customer outcome, deployment volume, or error metric was disclosed.
stories.watch: Earnings remarks, named deployments, and task-level outcome disclosures.
stories.date_exception: Quiet-day specialist update: October 22 organizational status move remains operationally relevant and is explicitly labeled dated_update; it does not count toward fresh-story minimum.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Wells Fargo, lane 7: added announced enterprise-AI ownership row; company disclosure, no deployment result disclosed.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI and Oracle announced development of Oracle AI Workspace to connect Oracle applications and data with ChatGPT under organization permissions and approvals.
stories.new_takeaway: The agent/tool-use shift is valuable first in constrained internal workflows; partner-reported user counts do not establish reliable regulated outcomes.
stories.why_now: The primary announcement is dated October 27.
stories.previous_coverage: The seven compared episodes did not cover this Oracle application integration.
stories.uncertainty: The partners did not disclose failure rates, financial-close reliability, access-control testing results, or correction rates.
stories.watch: Availability, access-control evidence, and independent task-level testing.
stories.frontier_bar: agent and tool-use advances; price/access shift

stories.new_fact: Freddie Mac said it plans to report third-quarter 2026 results before markets open October 29, with a 9 a.m. webcast.
stories.new_takeaway: A timetable is a concrete monitoring point, not a result or a policy change.
stories.why_now: The release date was announced October 27.
stories.previous_coverage: No compared script used this timetable.
stories.uncertainty: No earnings, portfolio, credit, or liquidity outcome is known until the release.

editorial_review.notes: Four fresh developments are consumer confidence, Columbus ballot guidance, the newly posted FHFA HPI report, OpenAI/Oracle workflow integration, and the Freddie Mac reporting timetable. The Wells Fargo banking-AI status move is explicitly a dated_update and does not count toward four fresh items. Compared both facts and takeaways against October 21–27; no full segment repeats a prior conclusion. Home lending is an evidence-refresh workflow, not a rate recap or AI segment. Frontier claims are explicitly partner-reported where applicable. Final structural review: target word count, cohost share, chapters, questions, lending specificity, AI evidence labels, source limits, and three closing watch items checked.
